title: Cocone
description: JSON Schema for a cocone under a diagram — an object N together with a family of morphisms (legs) n_j : D(j) → N from each vertex of the diagram, such that for every morphism f : j → j' in the index category, n_{j'} ∘ D(f) = n_j (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3). Dual to cone. Cocones are the candidate solutions for colimits; the colimit is the universal cocone.

cobase.description: The cocone's cobase object N — the common target of all the legs.

under-diagram.description: The diagram D : J → C this cocone is under.

legs.description: The leg morphisms n_j : D(j) → N, one per object of the index category.
